note: User-curated calibration universe (valuation-recalibration-spec §3.1: the UNIVERSE is part of the pre-stated target). The human OWNS this list. The AUTOMATED-fundamentals universe is SEC filers: US 10-K filers (full ~10yr EDGAR XBRL history) plus foreign 20-F/40-F filers (EDGAR IFRS, ~2022+ history). The owner curates by ADDING gate-plausible SEC-filing names; the /calibration page SUGGESTS additions (researched cases + 13F-discovered candidates) but never auto-derives the list. Names with no automated primary source (non-SEC filers on DFM/ADX) are marked status:'deferred' with a reason — listed for transparency but skipped, NEVER 'needs manual entry': the owner does not hand-key fundamentals and we do not use a keyed aggregator. Deferred names stay until an automated source exists. The local-manual adapter remains as an optional seam (a name COULD carry a local_manual hint if an audited entry ever existed) but it is no longer the expected path for the calibration universe. Edit this file to add/remove names; `version` is bumped on every change and a calibration_run records WHICH version it used for reproducibility.
